info.description: Locally reconstructed, NOT an official vendor OpenAPI document. Requests come from the downloaded vendor endpoint/helper scripts. Response models combine structural read observations and fields accepted by the current holita adapter; nullable variants are not a vendor guarantee. Unknown write/driver/black-box/queue response bodies remain unconstrained. See README.md and source/manifest.json.

KarmaSessionQuery.description: Secret session from POST /login. Used by GET/DELETE in vendor helper and by holita fixed GET reads. POST/PUT helper transport uses JSON-body karma_sid instead.

BusinessError.description: A JSON error envelope can be returned with HTTP 200, including Not logged in. No exhaustive error catalog is available.

session_id.description: Secret server-held session ID. No example value is retained.

LoginResponse.description: Observed login success shape; expiry and account permission metadata are unspecified.

Version.description: Public upstream version string. The observed version is metadata, not a compatibility guarantee.

Car.description: Observed car fields with holita-accepted optional null variants. No required list is inferred for the vendor contract.

car_year.description: Text observed; holita also accepts finite numbers and normalizes to a string.

driver_ids.description: Only empty arrays observed. Holita exposes the length, not driver identities.

sim_imsi.description: Observed only as null; non-null shape and meaning are not established. Not exposed by holita.

sim_phone.description: Observed only as null; non-null shape and meaning are not established. Not exposed by holita.

karma_video_data.description: Observed only as null; non-null shape and meaning are not established. Not exposed by holita.

vehicle_type.description: Observed only as null; non-null shape and meaning are not established. Not exposed by holita.

TimeZone.description: Vendor numeric time-zone lookup. No offset or DST rule is inferred.

User.description: Observed account user record. Active flag, expiry semantics and permissions are not inferred.

Role.description: Role reference with original text, not a permission model.

Location.description: Last-known message envelope; optional fields depend on selection. Timestamp meanings and metric units are not fully specified.

Event.description: Event message with raw eid code. No event-code dictionary is supplied.

Trip.description: Trip record with nullable stop values accepted by holita. Metric units and active-trip conventions are not established.

EdataParameter.description: Numeric parameter ID/value and optional description. Unknown IDs and zero are preserved; units/scaling are unspecified.

EdataMessage.description: eData message envelope with parameter readings.

SensorRecord.description: Observed sensor envelope only; no sensor reading schema is established and holita does not expose it.

sensors.description: Only null observed. Non-null payload shape is unknown.

DrivingCategory.description: Raw nullable score and weight; units, ranges and aggregation are unknown.

DrivingProfile.description: Per-car period aggregate; date-zone semantics are unresolved.

score.description: Nine source categories accepted by holita. No overall score is calculated.
